user.description: GE Home (SmartHQ) appliances can be set up automatically.

ge_home.title: GE appliance (SmartHQ)
ge_home.description: Pick the washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven or refrigerator. Its state, cycle, time-remaining and door entities are found automatically.

data_description.name: Shown as the Live Activity title. Blank = the device name.

data_description.remaining_entity: Hours, minutes or seconds — the unit is read from the sensor.
data_description.done_entity: Turns on when a cycle finishes. Optional, but makes 'Done' detection exact.
data_description.door_entity: Opening the door dismisses a finished Live Activity.

data.dismiss_minutes: Dismiss the finished Live Activity after
data.open_delay_seconds: Start the Live Activity after the door is open for

data_description.finished_alert: Changing a Live Activity to Done doesn't always alert you; this does.
data_description.dismiss_minutes: It is also dismissed as soon as the door opens.
data_description.open_delay_seconds: Quick grabs don't start a Live Activity (iOS limits how many can be started).
data_description.critical_after_minutes: Critical alerts bypass Silent and Focus until the door is closed.
